text.text_excerpt: The price was great cause of Hotels.com and I must say, aside from the parking sucking, like how anywhere in downtown is, this hotel was really good & comfortable. It's currently going thru renovations right now so it looks a little scruffed up, but overall, the condition of the room, quality of service, attitude... a lot were just a plus so yes, I'll definitely stay here again... well if the price is right of course. Que in the music...

I don't understand why there are so many negative reviews of the hotel online. Pros: -It's cheap! I stayed there on Friday Oct. 7 & Saturday Oct. 8 and only paid $79 per night. -They don't hold a charge for incidentals like most hotels so this is great if you're using a debit card to pay for the stay. -There is a restaurant and bar located in the hotel's lobby. -The rooms are different. I stayed in a room on the 7th floor and had a great view of the city. I was caught off guard that 2 of out the 4 walls of the room were mostly windows. It wasn't bad, just different. -The staff members were very bubbly. -It's not far from the French Quarters, Canal Street or Harrah's Casino. A cab from Bou...

An excellent hotel both close enough and far enough from the French Quarter. The staff was very nice especially with me shipping a package there and then when our flight got canceled and we didn't arrive until the next day. It was a very enjoyable stay and we would definitely stay here again.
